questions.question: What is the correct order of stages in a sales funnel?
questions.questionHtml: What is the correct order of stages in a sales funnel?

answers.text: Interest, Awareness, Action, Decision
Awareness, Interest, Decision, Action
Decision, Action, Awareness, Interest
Action, Decision, Interest, Awareness

questions.feedback: The four stages are Awareness (they learn you exist), Interest (they research you), Decision (they are ready to buy), and Action (they purchase).
questions.feedbackHtml: The four stages are Awareness, Interest, Decision, and Action.

questions.question: What is gated content?

answers.text: Content that requires payment to access
Valuable content offered in exchange for an email address
answers.textHtml: Valuable content offered in exchange for an email address

answers.text: Content hidden from search engines
Content that is password-protected for existing clients
answers.textHtml: Content that is password-protected for existing clients

questions.feedback: Gated content is valuable material (white papers, guides, case studies) offered for free in exchange for the visitor's email address, helping you build your mailing list.
questions.feedbackHtml: Gated content trades valuable information for email addresses to build your mailing list.

questions.question: Select ALL that apply: Which are effective offline marketing strategies for a drone business?
questions.questionHtml: Select ALL that apply: Which are effective offline marketing strategies for a drone business?

answers.text: Joining the local Chamber of Commerce
Giving educational presentations to potential client groups
answers.textHtml: Giving educational presentations to potential client groups

answers.text: Posting on social media daily
Vehicle branding with your logo and services
answers.textHtml: Vehicle branding with your logo and services

questions.feedback: Chamber of Commerce, educational presentations, and vehicle branding are offline strategies. Social media posting is online marketing.
questions.feedbackHtml: Chamber membership, presentations, and vehicle branding are effective offline strategies.

questions.question: What is the most important thing to track with paid advertising?
questions.questionHtml: What is the most important thing to track with paid advertising?

answers.text: How many people see your ad
How many likes or shares you receive
answers.textHtml: How many likes or shares you receive

answers.text: Whether the ad generates more revenue than it costs
answers.textHtml: Whether the ad generates more revenue than it costs

answers.text: How professional the ad looks

questions.feedback: Return on investment is what matters most. Views and engagement are meaningless if they do not convert into paying customers.
questions.feedbackHtml: ROI is the key metric — views and likes mean nothing if they do not generate revenue.

questions.question: Why should business assumptions be documented in your plan?
questions.questionHtml: Why should business assumptions be documented in your plan?

answers.text: To impress investors
So you can identify and manage the risks in your plan
answers.textHtml: So you can identify and manage the risks in your plan

answers.text: Because banks require them
To predict the future accurately

questions.feedback: Documenting assumptions helps you understand the risks in your plan. If assumptions prove wrong, you can quickly identify what needs to change.
questions.feedbackHtml: Documented assumptions help identify risks and enable quick adjustments when reality differs from projections.
